statement: For p in [1,infinity), Equation 5 is continuous on the ell_p(R^k) orbit space; for every compact K subset ell_p(R^k) and every continuous non-polynomial activation, the Equation 5 neural class is dense in C(K/G_infinity).
assumptions: k is finite and the norm on R^k is fixed
rho and sigma are continuous for continuity
the neural activation is continuous and non-polynomial for universality
G_infinity acts by finite permutations and the quotient uses the symmetrized ell_p metric
acceptance: the uniform-tail continuity implication is checked
scalar, addition, and product constructors are explicit and mutation-tested
the multiset-separation construction is audited and independently exhausted on a finite domain
the inner/outer UAT error budget closes for arbitrary positive epsilon
all three destructive controls are rejected
